evidence_items.explanation: The study evaluates DALL-E 2 on 15 basic physical and social relations using 169 human participants. It documents substantial failures in a central compositional task during the target period, while explaining why relational reasoning matters.
Winoground supplies earlier evidence of a broader difficulty across vision-language models. Its image-caption matching results are not an evaluation of Imagen and precede the target period.
